quotes.text: Lightweight theme background images reached the event and task dialog content through its iframe and obscured the lower event form. The accepted patch sets -moz-Dialog background on the two inner content elements, rather than broad extra elements. Review first removed unneeded targets and tested Windows 11. Check event and task dialog inner content with a theme background when editing inherited dialog styles.

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.
